description: The seed fixture (tests/common/seed.rs) uses pre-computed hardcoded timestamp strings (e.g. '2025-12-22T00:00:00Z') with a fixed baseline of 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z. A contributor might 'simplify' these to be relative to the actual system clock (e.g. 'N days ago from now'). But doing so would make tests non-deterministic: sort-by-date tests, filter-by-date tests, and before/after range tests would all produce different results depending on when the tests run. Fixed absolute timestamps are the correct oracle for a deterministic test suite.
title: seed.rs uses fixed hardcoded timestamps relative to a fixed baseline, not relative to system time
